title: 弥生賞の後に・生まれた戸惑い

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka performs incredibly at the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, seeing the other racers cry in frustration at their losses causes her to question her reason for running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Worried she won't be able to stay focused or run well in her distracted state, she requests to withdraw from the upcoming Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, knowing it's no good to continue without a goal on the books, I decide to enter her in the Kobe Shimbun Hai.
